network_dependencies_summary: Both skills are fundamentally online-first: they are thin instruction layers around the `npx shadcn@latest` CLI, whose core verbs (init --preset, apply, add of non-local items, search, view, docs, build's schema resolution) contact ui.shadcn.com and/or configured/GitHub registries, plus an optional MCP server (shadcn mcp) whose six tools all perform live registry lookups. The migrate-radix-to-base skill additionally instructs fetching registry style JSON directly by URL (https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/<style>/<component>.json) as its preferred 'golden pair' strategy. None of this will work offline; only the static prose/tables (rules, class-mapping, prop tables, wrapper shapes, consumer-props, universal-patterns, evals.json) are usable without a network connection. The migrate-radix-to-base per-family reference files (overlays.md, menus.md, form-controls.md, display-misc.md) also carry 'fetched 2026-07-02' provenance notes pointing at radix-ui.com/base-ui.com, but that fetch already happened when the file was authored — it is not a runtime dependency of using the skill itself.
